name: Solo Breeding
source:
The story follows a powerless protagonist who, one day, discovers a mysterious book in his front yard. Little did he know, this book would awaken his latent hunter skills, turning him into a force to be reckoned with. Living with his mother, sister, and a recently summoned zombie (thanks to his newfound abilities), he joins the prestigious Hunter's Academy.

There, he'll face thrilling challenges, make new friends and enemies, and experience love and romance like never before. But it won't be easy, as he'll have to fight his way through dangerous gates that threaten the very fabric of reality.
